angle_only.change: mask Bond primitive action contribution to zero without renormalizing Angle

bond_only.change: mask Angle primitive action contribution to zero without renormalizing Bond

reliability_off.change: Reliability output fixed to one; all else matched

xtb_single_point.delta_definition: (E_candidate - E_source) * 627.509474 kcal/mol; negative is candidate lower energy
xtb_single_point.failure_policy: explicit failure; finite matched pairs only with denominator accounting

xtb_subset.selection_rule: first 750 molecule identities after SHA256 rank of SIXS_XTB_ABLATION_V1|molecule_id
